subject: Demo availability — summit pulled Clara offsite, options to shift
messages:
From: Clara Wong <clara@solsticehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed 5/20 onsite

Hi Diego,

Quick heads up — leadership just pulled me into a partner summit the week of 5/18 for on-site coordination (travel into Seattle starts Sunday). I won’t be able to host the in-person session we planned for Wed 5/20. I still really want to see Redwood and keep momentum.

Options that would work on our side:
- Convert the session to a recorded walkthrough (we'd watch asynchronously; follow up with a short live Q&A)
- Have a colleague cover live on 5/20 (Tom could host briefly but he’s not deep on infra)
- Move the onsite to the following week (5/25–5/28) — our team is tight but possible

Can you send what would be easiest for you? If recorded is simplest, share any checklist for what to include and an estimated turnaround.

Sorry for the late notice. Appreciate the flexibility.

— Clara
Clara Wong
Director, Clinical Programs
Solstice Health

From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Wong <clara@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@solsticehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed 5/20 onsite

Thanks Clara — totally understand, and congrats on the summit pull. We can run with any of those three paths. Short replies to each option and next steps below so we can lock something by end of day: 

1) Recorded walkthrough (fastest)
- We can put together a 12–15 minute product walkthrough focused on your pilot use case (prefix caching, latency SLOs, and cost controls).
- Deliverables: edited MP4 + short timestamped slide notes + a 20–30 min live Q&A session (30 min max) the week of 5/25.
- ETA: recording + edit in 2 business days (if we record Monday).

2) Coverage by Tom / internal host on 5/20
- Marissa can run the demo live and I can join remotely for the infra/ops portion. Marissa, can you take point if Clara wants this? We’ll send a 30-min prep doc.

3) Move onsite to 5/25–5/28
- We’re flexible on that window; if you want to keep it in-person we can tentatively hold 5/26.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan with the proposed deliverables and a quick calendar file with suggested time slots. If recorded is the path of least resistance, reply with preferred Q&A windows (we suggested 5/26 11:00–11:30 PT and 5/27 09:00–09:30 PT).

Next step: pick which option feels best and the preferred Q&A/cover slot and we’ll act.

Thanks — and happy to be flexible.

Diego Fernández
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf, proposed_times.ics

From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo — Wed 5/20 onsite — heads up and potential cover

Marissa / Monica / Mina — forwarding Clara's note. Short ask: if Clara chooses coverage for 5/20, can Marissa run the demo? Marissa, you'll have Marissa-level action items below:
- I’ll produce a 1-page prep doc (tech checklist + run of show).
- If you can lead the demo I’ll take the infra Q&A remotely.
- Monica / Mina: can you compile any customer-facing slides (pilot success examples) and a quick runbook for the recording option?

If recorded route chosen, Monica — see the demo-recording-guidelines.docx attached; it includes editing notes and timestamps that resonate with clinical teams.

Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood demo — Wed 5/20 onsite — heads up and potential cover

I can cover 5/20 live if Clara prefers that route. Quick questions:
- Do we want the session to be 45 min or a condensed 30 min? I’d recommend 30 (15 demo + 15 ops/Q&A) since Tom may not be technical.
- Please send the 1-page prep and the slide pack for customer-specific examples.
- I’ll block 5/20 10:00–10:45 PT tentatively and will swap if Diego confirms recorded path.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@solsticehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>, Clara Wong <clara@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed 5/20 onsite

Diego / Team — thanks for the quick options. Clara and I chatted and we’ll go with the recorded walkthrough + a short live Q&A. Please: 
- Deliver the 12–15 min recording by EOD Mon 5/18 PT (so our team can watch before the summit)
- Schedule a 30-min Q&A on Tue 5/26 at 11:00 PT — Tom + Clara + 2 others will join.

Clara, Diego — feel free to send the prep doc / checklist to ops@solsticehealth.com. Looking forward to it.

— Tom
Senior Program Manager, Field Ops
Solstice Health
